# penlike

> Model how an author, a group or a corpus writes, register by register, and give agents the skills to write in that style

- [penlike.screening](_autosummary/penlike.screening.html.md): Screening: keeping machine-written text out of a model of a person. Optional.
- [penlike.sourcers](_autosummary/penlike.sourcers.html.md): Sourcers: where the writing comes from. Read-only, by construction.
- [penlike.store](_autosummary/penlike.store.html.md): Where models live, and the one object that reads and writes them.
- [penlike.tools](_autosummary/penlike.tools.html.md): The verbs: every operation penlike offers, as plain functions returning JSON-ready dicts.
